report_item: Report a found item. Body: description, place (where it was found), date_found (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the item including its id and claimed (false for a new item).
list_items: List all items on the board, claimed or not.
list_unclaimed: List only the items that have not been claimed yet.
get_item: Get one item by its id, with description, place, date_found, claimed (true/false) and owner_name (empty/null until claimed). Path params: id.
claim_item: Mark an item as claimed by its owner. Path params: id (the item). Body: owner_name. Refused when the item is already claimed.
